examples.arabic: الآن، يجتمع قادتنا في قمة طارئة في بيروت لبحث حلول مستدامة لهذه المشكلة الملحة التي تؤرق شعوبنا.
examples.english: Now, our leaders are meeting in an emergency summit in Beirut to discuss sustainable solutions for this pressing problem that troubles our peoples.
examples.transliteration: Al-aan, yajtame' qadatna fi qimmat tari'ah fi Beirut libahth hulul mustadamah li-hadhihi al-mushkilah al-mulihhah allati tu'arriq shu'oobana.
examples.storyTitle: Voice of the Levant: The Water Summit and Fateful Decisions

examples.arabic: المشكلة إنو زباينه ناطرين برا، وما ضل عنده غير كيسين بس، وهاد الشي ما بيكفي ليعمل قهاويهم اللي بيشربوها مع مناقيش الزعتر.
examples.english: The problem is that his customers are waiting outside, and he only has two bags left, and this thing does not suffice to make their coffees which they drink with thyme manakish.
examples.transliteration: El mushkle inno zabayno natrin barra, w ma dall ando gher kisin bas, w had el shi ma byekfi la yaamel ahawihom elli byeshrabuha maa manakish el zaatar.

examples.arabic: فادي بده يشرب قهوة بس في مشكلة
examples.english: Fadi wants to drink coffee but there is a problem
examples.transliteration: fadi bidu yishrab qahwa bas fi mushkila

examples.arabic: فجأة، دخل جارو الختيار أبو سامي حامل منقوشتين زعتر سخنين وسألو عن المشكلة.
examples.english: Suddenly, his elderly neighbor Abu Sami entered holding two hot zaatar manakish and asked him about the problem.
examples.transliteration: Fajaah, dakhal jaro el khtyar Abu Sami hamil manqoushtein zaatar sukhnin wa saalo an el mushkileh.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Number in the Garage

examples.english: There is a small problem here.

examples.arabic: قلت لهن هاي مشكلة مزعجة كتير لازم نحلها بسرعة
examples.english: I told them this is a very annoying problem that we need to solve quickly
examples.transliteration: Qult lahon hay mushkileh moz'ajeh kteer lazem nehella bi sur'a
